summary: Staggered offboarding + temporary privileged access request for senior eng handover
description:
Issue summary: Senior engineer (Eve Ramirez) is leaving on 2026-03-20 but will perform a knowledge-transfer period until 2026-03-27. Manager requests a staggered offboarding where some admin privileges are retained for an additional 7 days strictly for handover tasks.

Request: Define and implement a temporary, auditable privileged access window (whitelist specific roles/resources) instead of full admin retention. Clarify policy for 3rd-party repo access and production AWS keys during handover.

Why this matters: Project 'Search-Optimizer' has in-flight rollback playbook only Eve knows; immediate revocation will block handover and risk production regressions. Security is concerned about retaining high privileges after exit. Need a controlled compromise with logging/approval.
impact: Potential blocking of critical handover for Search-Optimizer; if privileges removed immediately, on-call and SRE will not have context to rollback or finish migration. Security risk if privileges extended without controls.
access_to_remove: Redwood Console: full-admin -> reduce to project-admin on 2026-03-21 unless approved
GitHub org: org-admin -> maintain repo-admin for search-optimizer repo only
AWS: remove root/organization admin; create time-bound IAM role with assume-role for 7 days
Vault: rotate owner tokens and create time-limited access path
equipment_return: MacBook Pro 14" serial C02X1ABCDFGH - return by 2026-03-27
YubiKey #7 - to be returned at access termination
Dell UltraSharp 27" monitor - asset tag RDW-3421 - schedule pickup
steps: 1) Manager (R. Patel) to sign off on handover scope in HR form (link below)
2) Security to create a time-limited privileged role in AWS/IAM and document assume-role MFA requirement
3) IAM to reduce org-level privileges and grant repo-level admin for specified repos
4) SRE to coordinate runbook walkthroughs recorded via Zoom and uploaded to Confluence
5) Audit logs to be retained and exported to security S3 bucket for the 7-day window
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Rajiv Patel (Manager): I approve limited access to the Search-Optimizer repo and a 7-day assume-role for AWS so Eve can finish the rollback script. Will be present for handover sessions.
2026-03-10 10:05 - Asha Patel (HR): Noted. HR will complete exit checklist and confirm last day. Will escalate if legal needs to be involved.

2026-03-11 14:46 - Priya Kapoor (Security): We need Security Council approval for time-bound admin roles. Interim: create 'handover-priv' role with session tag and enforced MFA. See Slack thread #security-privs-thread (https://slack.redwood/support/archives/CP12345).

2026-03-12 08:22 - Liam O'Connor (IT): I started a draft IAM policy and a temporary role template. Attaching draft here: https://confluence.redwood.company/handovers/INT-7810-draft (pending security review).
investigation_notes: Checked current access: Eve has org-admin on GitHub, console:full-admin, AWS:PowerUser with some admin policies; Vault owner on /secret/search-opt. Full admin removal would break CI deploy keys used by the rollback job.
SRE flagged runbook dependencies: deploy key checks and cassandra compaction script that only exists in Eve's forks.
Security endorsement: time-limited assume-role with logging meets compliance if approved by CSO; recommended 7 days with daily attestations.
HR policy: standard offboarding policy requires revocation of admin within 24 hours unless there's a documented exception with manager + security sign-off.
resolution: Pending: Security approval required. Proposed interim solution implemented: created 'handover-priv' role (assume-role, MFA required, session max 12 hours) scoped to Search-Optimizer AWS resources and repo-admin on search repo only. Access scheduled to auto-expire on 2026-03-27. HR to collect signed exception form. Final tasks: rotate any long-lived credentials Eve used and confirm audit export to security S3.
